workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya Raman's and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the meeting next week:

Mon Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
Tue Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
Thu Nov 19: 10:00, 14:30
Fri Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which slot works for them. Then I'll book it.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor. The only time from your list that works for everyone is Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. Please book that 30-minute slot. I'll wait for your confirmation before sending the email to the partners.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. It's in the system. You can go ahead and send the confirmation email.
